scientific_integrity: All-prime-power assertions are supported by a symbolic proof. Finite exhaustive checks support, but do not replace, the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Only the dyadic cubic graph and its constant-input fourth Fourier moment are treated; pointwise root solving is standard; an earlier local-density computation might imply the aggregate formulas.
title: Dyadic cubic curve: exact fourth Fourier moments and two-sum support
